chunks: I want no sustenance from them nor do I want them to feed Me.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He wants no sustenance from His creation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat underscores Allah's absolute independence (Al-Ghani) from the material needs of His creation, refuting anthropomorphic conceptions of the Divine. It serves as a theological foundation for the concept that worship is for the benefit of the worshippers, not a necessity for God, emphasizing that sustenance (rizq) is bestowed by Him rather than earned by Him.
